classOutput

packages/sql-semantics/src/Rendering/Output.php:27
final class Output
Restricted visibility: declared "@visibility SqlSemantics". Code outside that scope must not name this declaration.

The typed, temporary output a statement structure is written to.

Nodes add keywords, punctuation, names and literal spellings; there is no operation that adds a free SQL fragment. The pieces are joined into text by the lexical writer. Explicit toString() calls check that observable layouts only respell those pieces; constructing or executing a statement does not call this renderer to recover semantic information.

A dialect whose server reads a comment, such as an optimizer hint comment, writes it here; the comment separates the pieces as a space does and adds no token.

public function layout(?Layout $layout, Node $node, bool $leading = false): $this
source§

Writes a node in the spelling of a layout, or regularly when there is none.

The node renders its pieces as always; each piece then takes the spelling and the preceding trivia of the layout token at its position, and the next piece written takes the trailing trivia of the layout. Inside a spelled region a nested layout has no effect, since the outer layout spells every token of the region.

Parameters

$layout?Layout
$nodeNode
$leadingboolWhether the dialect has validated observable trivia before the first token

Returns

$this

Throws

InvariantViolation When the layout does not have one token per rendered piece
